desc: Derive closed form for p_k(u,v): k>v → 0; k=v → 1; u<k<v → 1/k; k=u → (k-1)/k; 2≤k<u → 2(k-1)/(k(k+1)) (via Pólya urn Beta(1,k-1) mixing, E[θ²]=2/(k(k+1)))
Establish prefix-sum structure: ans(u,v) = (N-1)!·(S1[u-1] + A_u·(u-1)/u + S2[v-1]−S2[u] + A_v), with S1[i]=Σ_{k≤i} A_k·2(k-1)/(k(k+1)), S2[i]=Σ_{k≤i} A_k/k
Implement final solution: O(N) precompute of inverses and prefix sums, O(1) per query, fast stdin/stdout

Verify solution against brute-force reasoning for small N (N=3,4 exact match), samples 1–2, and edge cases u=1, v=u+1, N=2; audit code indexing (S2 range for u=1, `lo` guard, factorial loop bounds, inv recurrence)
